cases.command: sudo -u deploy timeout 30 npm run build

description: Cross-language conformance fixtures for shell prefix-runner (wrapper) unwrapping. Both the TypeScript @themoltnet/shell-command-analyzer and the Go github_guard (apps/moltnet-cli) must resolve each command to the same final executable `target`. This locks the shared wrapper flag tables against drift (e.g. sudo --command-timeout) while each keeps its own parser. Scoped to the wrappers both implementations know (env, nohup, sudo, timeout, xargs) and to flag forms both parse identically (separate/inline value flags, boolean flags, --, positionals, assignments). Attached short-value forms (e.g. `sudo -uroot`) are intentionally omitted: the Go guard fails closed on them while the analyzer resolves them.
